name: Market Brawl
speedNote: Measured on the current build, 11 worker threads (README, Throughput). The recorded run's own wall time was not logged.

events.verdict: Ultra's patch fixed 1 of 1 seeds but is not shipped; a narrower hand fix is shipped and replay-verified 1 of 1

replays.note: Sampled recorded rounds replayed event for event in Node (README, Replay).

adapter: The original target. Needed window and DOM shims plus Three.js in Node to run headless.
notes: Personas were written for this game: their rules use fighting vocabulary (distance, rival, punch).
Real-time contact between two physics bodies is where the crowd found the most bugs.
